items.title: An Update from the Anti-Cheat Team - 11/12/2026
items.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/df293d855b99510b1a15e50a9bc8112a48f1227d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Competitive Integrity Update: Controller Cheating Enforcement[/b][/p][p]We have deployed enhanced controller cheating detections in all Apex Legends game modes, on all platforms. Players identified using unauthorized controller hardware, modifications, or software to gain an unfair gameplay advantage will be subject to enforcement, including permanent bans.[/p][p]Over the past several months, our Anti-Cheat team has been testing and validating impactful new tools to add to our controller cheating detection systems. Throughout this process, we've seen strong results, and those tools have now reached the level of validation necessary for full implementation.[/p][p]These detections apply across ALL PLATFORMS, including PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. Playing on console does not provide an exemption from detection or enforcement.[/p][p]We want to be clear: if you are using unauthorized devices, controller modifications, or software to gain an unfair advantage, you should stop immediately. Do not assume these tools are undetectable or that your platform will protect you from enforcement.[/p][p]We have invested significant time in testing and validating these enhancements to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior.[/p][p]This is an important step forward in addressing controller-based cheating, but it is not the end of these efforts. We will continue improving and evolving our detection capabilities as cheating methods change.[/p][p]Fair play is for everyone, and we will continue taking action against those who compromise the competitive integrity of Apex Legends.[/p]

items.title: An Update from the Anti-Cheat Team – Nov 4, 2026
items.contents: [h1]Ranked Integrity Update – Rookie Rank Exploit[/h1][p]We recently identified and quickly resolved an exploit that allowed some players, primarily on PlayStation 5, to enter Ranked matches as Rookie IV regardless of their actual rank.[/p][p]This caused several unintended advantages, including:[/p][list][*][p]No Ranked entry cost[/p][/*][*][p]Rookie-tier kill bonuses[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking Rating (MMR) being recorded as 0[/p][/*][*][p]RP earned during these matches still being added to the player's actual Ranked score[/p][/*][/list][p]This created an unfair advantage and directly impacted the integrity of Ranked progression.[/p][p]Our Anti-Cheat team identified the root cause and deployed a fix to prevent further abuse. We also conducted an investigation into accounts that benefited from this exploit and took enforcement action against players who deliberately and egregiously abused it.[/p][h1]Enforcement Results[/h1][p]A total of [b]905 accounts[/b] have been banned, with suspension lengths determined by the amount of RP gained through exploitation:[/p][list][*][p]731 accounts were banned for 120 days for illegitimately amassing up to 4,999 RP[/p][/*][*][p]107 accounts were banned for 240 days for illegitimately amassing 5,000–9,999 RP[/p][/*][*][p]67 accounts were banned for 365 days for illegitimately amassing 10,000+ RP[/p][/*][/list][h1]Enforcement by Platform[/h1][list][*][p]PC: 12[/p][/*][*][p]PlayStation: 848[/p][/*][*][p]Xbox: 44[/p][/*][*][p]Nintendo Switch 2: 2[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Total RP deducted: 15,112,554[/b][/p][p]We recognize that some players may have encountered this issue unintentionally. Through our investigation, we were able to precisely identify cases of unintended interaction and distinguish them from deliberate abuse. Those accounts were not actioned.[/p][p]Ranked integrity depends on a fair and consistent competitive environment. Exploits that undermine matchmaking, bypass Ranked entry requirements, or provide illegitimate progression will be investigated and actioned.[/p][p]Our team will continue monitoring Ranked, looking for similar activity and addressing vulnerabilities that could be used to compromise competitive integrity.[/p]

items.title: Hack the fight in Apex Legends™: Cipher
items.contents: [h3]In this ring, the deadliest weapon isn’t a gun, it’s information. Crypto’s new firmware update switches his role to aggressive intel-gathering, the Akimbo Wingman adds deadly precision firepower, and new Strongholds offer high-stakes, high-tier loot.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/fc9154c750debb06b5bf7281696fbd54db07168e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Decrypt the Battlefield[/b][/p][p]Thanks to a new firmware upgrade from his sister Mila, Crypto’s role has switched from passive to aggressive intel-gathering. His Surveillance Drone now runs on batteries instead of a cooldown, and the new Sentry Mode tags enemies in sight for you and your squad. Plus, his EMP Ultimate can now be deployed with the press of a button. You’ll know their next move before they do.[/p][p][b]Wingmen Don’t Fly Solo[/b][/p][p]If the deadliest weapon is information, the second deadliest is dual-wielded revolvers. The Akimbo Wingman is a dangerous combo of precision and firepower. Take aim, choose your shots carefully, and be the dead-eyed sharpshooter you were born to be.[/p][p][b]Raid New Strongholds[/b][/p][p]New Strongholds are the evolution of Care Packages, bringing high-tier, high-risk loot in a very loud package. Raid a Stronghold to haul out crate weapons, Corrupted Attachments, and EVO for your whole squad, but opening it takes time and trips an alarm that tells everyone nearby exactly where you are. Plan your heist and take the loot, or let another squad ring the dinner bell for you.[/p][p][b]Revenant + Lifeline Rebooted[/b][/p][p]Play Revenant more aggressively with a shorter Ultimate cooldown, a quicker Tactical, and new Upgrades that extend your Ultimate with every knock. Keep your squad in the fight with Lifeline’s reduced cooldown on D.O.C. and self-heal while gliding, plus new Upgrades that add a shield while you revive a teammate and improve flight mobility.[/p][p][b]Ranked Legend Bans[/b][/p][p]The Arena shifts every match with new Legend Bans in Diamond lobbies and above. Every player casts 1 vote to ban a Legend. The more votes a Legend gets, the greater the chance they’ll be banned for that match, so make sure you have a Plan B. Maybe a Plan C.[/p][p][b]New Mythic Volt[/b][/p][p]Crypto’s digital fingerprints are all over this season’s new Mythic Volt SMG, the Cryptic Core, with a built-in PALS assistant rendered in glorious low-res pixel art. Reprogram the swarm with Exotic Shards: each retheme slams in a new retro game cartridge and switches the nanites to a new vibe and color. Available as a possible drop in Cipher Seasonal Packs*.[/p][p][b]Suit Up in Nanotech Style[/b][/p][p]Unlock Legendary skins for Ash and Axle, a new Legendary Weapon Skin for the Triple Take, along with 10 Exotic Shards, and the Reactive Wingman skin at Tier 60 with the Cipher Premium Battle Pass Split 1.[/p][p][/p][p]*Not available in all regions.[/p][p][/p]

items.title: Apex Legends™: Cipher Patch Notes
items.contents: [h3]ICYMI: [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/news/31-0-designers-notes"]Designers Notes[/url][/h3][h2][b]CIPHER OVERVIEW[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Apex Legends: Cipher is here! It’s bringing new features, new weapon combos, and big changes to Ranked alongside the usual slew of bug fixes and balancing passes. Read on for info about the Akimbo Wingman, Strongholds, new Ranked features and more! Season 31 begins on November 3rd, so get the squad together and get ready to jump into Apex Legends: Cipher![/p][h2][b]RANKED LEGEND BANNING AND SCORING ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We recently unveiled upcoming plans for new features, quality of life improvements, and adjustments coming to Ranked over the next two seasons.[/p][p align="start"]Starting in Cipher, we’re launching Legend Banning in Diamond+ matches, allowing you to vote for Legends to be banned from selection for each match. Scoring adjustments for wide-skill matches will also be live at season start and will adjust entry costs if your Rank is too far above or below the median lobby rank.[/p][p align="start"]Read on for all of the details, or circle back to [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/news/ranked-roadmap-31-32"][u]the Ranked Roadmap blog[/u][/url] to see what’s still on the horizon.[/p][h2][b]AKIMBO WINGMAN[/b][/h2][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6orWgSJiAERNRQ8zy9Jxwh/233653cd5d98be753b51ea9801c7fd63/Apex_S31-Season_Akimbo-Wingman-16x9.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5286458333333334,yPosition=0.47962962962962963" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The Wingman’s firepower is being doubled. Akimbo Wingman joins the weapon roster as a formidable foe at close and mid-range, leaving Legends’ bodies in its wake. Find them in ground loot, or at Heavy Arsenals, and gear up to become the fastest gun-slinger in the Apex Games.[/p][list][*][p]Ammo type changed from Sniper Ammo to Heavy Ammo[/p][list][*][p]Now takes Heavy Magazines instead of Sniper Magazines[/p][/*][*][p]Now spawns on Heavy Ammo Arsenals instead of Sniper Ammo Arsenals[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Base damage decreased from 50 to 45[/p][/*][*][p]Loot a second Wingman to automatically enter Akimbo[/p][/*][*][p]Akimbo Mode:[/p][list][*][p]Decreases headshot multiplier to 1.25x[/p][list][*][p]Headshot damage: 56[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Slightly increases rate of fire[/p][/*][*][p]Increases reload time[/p][/*][*][p]Increases recoil[/p][/*][*][p]Magazine size is doubled[/p][/*][*][p]Firing the Akimbo Wingman will cause each gun to fire one after the other, in a quick burst[/p][list][*][p]Holding down the trigger releases subsequent bursts[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]STRONGHOLDS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Now Dropping into the Apex Games: the Stronghold. In addition to our existing Care Packages and Replicators, these new Structures will airdrop onto the map near the mid game.[/p][p align="start"]Strongholds are locked, bunker-style structures that deploy dynamic cover and contain valuable loot. Players must occupy and control the zone surrounding the Stronghold to capture them. When captured, Strongholds will unlock, rewarding one level up to the capturing team. The loot contents of Strongholds will be a mix of rare loot, including Care Package weapons.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/482Rux3799ydqBtyUnc8BK/fe4c7f2307c599a087331d52ef170a72/Apex_S31-Season_Strongholds-16x9.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5916666666666667,yPosition=0.5305555555555556" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]Stronghold Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Airdrop timing to accommodate Strongholds[/p][list][*][p]2x Care Packages drop during Round 1 closing[/p][/*][*][p]1x Care Package drop during Round 2 closing[/p][/*][*][p]1x Stronghold drop during Round 2 closing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Strongholds crush (and KILL) players and objects underneath them on landing[/p][/*][*][p]Strongholds drop Dynamic cover upon landing[/p][list][*][p]If there is enough space, Strongholds will deploy up to 4 indestructible barriers, and 2 Hardlight frames[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Strongholds cannot:[/p][list][*][p]Be accessed or entered until captured[/p][/*][*][p]Be stolen from by Loba until captured[/p][/*][*][p]Be breached by Alter until captured[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Strongholds are Captured by controlling the Zone surrounding the structure[/p][list][*][p]Capture Progress is made whenever there is only 1 team alive in the Capture Zone[/p][/*][*][p]Capture is Contested when more than one team is present in the Zone[/p][/*][*][p]Capture Progress is globally shared and cannot decay[/p][/*][*][p]Capture Progress is faster when multiple teammates are present[/p][/*][*][p]The capturing team is whichever team is in the Zone when Capture Progress reaches 100%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When Captured,[/p][list][*][p]The Stronghold’s doors and roof hatch will open[/p][/*][*][p]The Stronghold awards a Level Up to each living member of the capturing team[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stronghold Loot Contents[/p][list][*][p]1x Care Package Weapon[/p][/*][*][p]3x Gold Guns[/p][/*][*][p]3x Amps[/p][/*][*][p]2x Corrupted Attachments[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]For more information about the implementation of Akimbo Wingman and Strongholds, please read our most recent [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/news/31-0-designers-notes"][u]Designer’s Notes[/u][/url].[/p][h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2][h3][b]LEGEND BUFFS[/b][/h3][p][b]Crypto[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Crypto is a very difficult Legend to play but a lot of the time he’s camping in his drone instead of fighting with his team. With these improvements we’re looking to keep what makes Crypto unique and strong but encourage using the drone in a more aggressive style while equipping him to stay with his team.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ally.MoveTo()[/b] (Speed Boost towards Teammates) Upgrade has now been integrated into the base kit[/p][/*][*][p]The speed boost has been slightly reduced[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crypto’s drone now has a battery system instead of lasting for ever[/p][/*][*][p]With the battery, the drone has a limited time of 25s to perform its actions before being recalled[/p][/*][*][p]After recalling, the drone can be redeployed without waiting for a cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Recall time is 6s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased handling and speed while in the drone[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies within line of sight of the drone can be scanned and marked; the marking ability has a 4s cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies get marked with an icon that will allow you to track enemies even if the drone is recalled or destroyed[/p][list][*][p]You cannot re-apply the mark to an enemy that is already marked[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies are marked for 8s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The base scan zone has been updated to 360 instead of just camera view, it also no longer scans lootbins and doors[/p][/*][*][p]While in drone mode you can press the shoot button to manually fire the mark[/p][/*][*][p]Sped up transition time when entering the drone[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]While Piloting[/b][/p][list][*][p]Crypto can trigger the EMP similar to the previous version[/p][/*][*][p]The player can press the Ultimate button on PC and the Y button on Console[/p][list][*][p]The Shoot button is now used for marking enemies[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Out of pilot mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]The EMP triggers on the drone that has been deployed[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Self Deploying Drone[/b][/p][list][*][p]As long as Crypto has an available drone that isn’t destroyed and isn’t out in the world he can deploy the drone and activate the EMP by triggering his Ultimate[/p][/*][*][p]The drone that is deployed for the Ultimate will trigger the EMP after a short delay[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If the EMP has line of sight to an enemy, it will deal full shield damage and a heavier slow; If the EMP does not have line of sight, it will deal 50 damage and a lighter slow[/p][/*][*][p]Crypto will not damage himself with his own EMP[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4QKnOD54GDKDEQemQ9P8qo/86ff464499b9adb9f4f806963489f8d2/03._Crypto_Upgrade_Tree.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.7369791666666666,yPosition=0.5305555555555556" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]LVL 2 - Ally.MoveTo()[/b] (Speed Boost towards teammates) replaced by [b]Got Eyes On You[/b] (Enemies remain marked for 4s longer)[/p][p align="start"][b]LVL 3 - Hackathon[/b] (Speed up drone recharge rate) replaced by [b]Charged Up[/b] (10s longer drone battery lifetime)[/p][p][b]Lifeline[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Lifeline is a great healer and can offer some clutch revives but we are seeing her playrate drop off as you climb ranks. We wanted to bring back some nostalgia by utilizing Upgrades to contribute to a feeling of stronger end game build.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]D.O.C. now heals Lifeline while she is gliding[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced Tactical cooldown from 25s to 15s[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4KT9QOG0iFbUgYkajF22Fs/836e905695f2627c2ec0035f5dfb7b79/04._Lifeline_Upgrade_Tree.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.7286458333333333,yPosition=0.5509259259259259" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]LVL 2 - BattPack[/b] (+1 battery slots) replaced by [b]Enhanced Radio (moved from LVL3)[/b] (Increased assign distance)[/p][/*][*][p][b]LVL 2 - Improved Flight[/b] provides better glide handling and increased duration[/p][/*][*][p][b]LVL 3 - Enhanced Radio (moved to LVL2)[/b] (Increased assign distance) is replaced by [b]Ultimate Cooldown[/b] (60 second ultimate cooldown reduction)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]LVL 3 - Tactical Cooldown[/b] (Reduce Tactical cooldown by 10 seconds) replaced by [b]Revive Shield[/b] (D.O.C. deploys shield while reviving)[/p][p][b]Revenant[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev note: We wanted to give Revenant some more interesting choices with his Upgrades. items.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/addba2b9b0a8d75ddf850b7afbdb0a76eafbbdfc.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]TLDR;[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Read on to hear all about major changes to Ranked coming in Season 31 and 32, including:[/p][list][*][p]NEW Legend Banning[/p][/*][*][p]Scoring adjustments for wide-skill matches[/p][/*][*][p]UI clarity improvements[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Iron, Emerald, and Grandmaster Ranks[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Pro-Am League[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked rewards overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Over the next two seasons, we are adding major improvements and features to Ranked mode in Apex Legends™. As we worked to create these additions, we had a few guiding design philosophies; things we want to ensure that players feel about the mode:[/p][list][*][p]Ranked is the most competitive way to play Apex Legends[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked is rewarding for all who play[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked provides more ways to showcase your accomplishments[/p][/*][*][p]There is trust in fairness of competition[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]While you read about the changes coming to the next two seasons, keep in mind: This isn’t everything. There are more changes to come, both in the short term and beyond Season 32, and as we approach each season, we will provide more detailed information about the additions and changes. Keep an eye out for more updates down the line![/p][h2][b]SEASON 31[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 31, starting in November, we’re adding a Legend Ban system in Diamond+ matches, meaningful score adjustments, and other quality of life improvements. The intention here is to make changes that provide tangible value to players and lay the foundation for larger changes that come in Season 32, in early 2027.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h3][b]LEGEND BANNING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Legend Banning has been a long-discussed feature, internally and externally, and we’re excited to bring it to life in Season 31 to help break up dominant metas at high-tier Ranked play, and keep the Ranked experience fresh and exciting. Legend Banning will be enabled alongside Drop Zone deployment, so that any match with Diamond+ players will use the feature. [/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5MLwY6NtTx3xMlLBRjdgJ8/54483a79d30fe84d555f90aa0f128ca1/Apex_2026_Legend_Ban_Vid_-_Thumbnail.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The pre-match flow for Diamond+ matches now includes a dedicated Banning Phase, where each player will get to choose one Legend for possible banning.[/p][p align="start"]Once all players have elected a Legend for banning (or the selection timer expires), all chosen Legends will display their chance of being banned for that match. The percent chance of being banned is determined by the total votes for that Legend - more votes, higher chance of being banned.[/p][p align="start"]The system then randomly selects Legends using the percentages, and players move onto the Legend Selection phase where banned Legends cannot be chosen by any player for that match.[/p][p align="start"][i][b]Why not just ban the most-voted Legends, you ask?[/b][/i][/p][p align="start"]While we did consider this as a solution, the overall goal of Legend Banning is to help keep the meta fresh by disrupting dominant patterns in Legend picks. A system that consistently bans the most-voted Legends creates its own banning meta, and it works directly against that goal. [/p][p align="start"]As with all of our new features, we will monitor how this impacts Legend selection across all games, and continue to iterate on it as we find opportunities for improvement.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]SCORING ADJUSTMENTS FOR WIDE-SKILL LOBBIES[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 31, while we continue to refine matchmaking, we’re making changes to entry costs to make matches with wide skill distributions feel more fair.[/p][p align="start"]In Ranked games, our matchmaker works to balance queue times and RP match width. During periods of low population we see both queue times and match width increase, occasionally resulting in long queue times or lobbies with very wide spread of Rank Tiers. We are introducing these scoring changes to reflect the risk (and opportunity for reward!) that these games represent for all of the players involved.[/p][p align="start"]Each Ranked lobby will have a “Lobby Tier” designation visible upon loading into a match; essentially the median of all squads. Any squad that is 2 or more Rank Tiers above or below the lobby’s Ranked Tier will have their entry costs adjusted.[/p][p align="start"]If you are two or more tiers [i]below[/i] the Lobby Tier, you will be entering a CHALLENGER match and your entry costs will be reduced.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1g7Tev1JwKJxdBuDi19xjq/7624e68b97ad781757c2a7fc965ee8ba/02._Challenger_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.7427790788446527,yPosition=0.8575305291723202" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In theory, your chance of winning that match is lower, so we want Entry Costs to align. If you do manage to come out ahead, congrats, you beat the odds and probably need to be in a higher Rank Tier anyways.[/p][p align="start"]If you are two or more tiers [i]above[/i] the Lobby Tier, you’re loading into a GOLIATH match, and will see increased entry costs.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7JeHlyDvzCpn6x7rGAIt9H/f1c4fab90d8b0aadb47cf9b1876a944a/03._Goliath_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.697111631537861,yPosition=0.8975576662143826" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Your chance of winning is much much higher and your Entry Cost will be increased to reflect it. You should be able to feast on all those lowbies, and still come out RP positive, right?[/p][p align="start"]Let’s look at an example:[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/TvrquvCJVZSnVDYBYhFhL/92791b702ecf5f467ae19a3953af98bb/04._Wide_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.1758391881342701,yPosition=0.08955223880597014" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In the above match, the Lobby Tier is set at Gold. Gold, Silver and Platinum squads are within acceptable bounds, but the Bronze squads will be marked as Challengers, and the Diamond squad will be marked as Goliaths.[/p][p align="start"]We want it to be clear what type of match you are going into, to help you strategize how you want to approach each lobby. This is why the RP adjustment is made to the Entry Cost, instead of being revealed only at the end. We want you to understand what has to be done in this match to break even and go positive in RP.[/p][p align="start"]For this change to scoring, we’ll be keeping a very close eye on player progression, as well as how much of an Entry Cost adjustment is required to reward players that can overcome the odds, and to prevent extreme boosting of squads that can easily nuke the entire lobby.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]EASIER ACCESS TO RANKED[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Road to Ranked Challenges are being removed and access to Ranked will move back to only requiring  Account Level 20. We will continue to explore the specific level threshold to find the perfect fit to provide the best player experience for all. [/p][p align="start"]Road to Ranked was intended as a skill-check for new accounts, ensuring that new players understood the rules of BR Trios, and had enough time on sticks to prove to themselves (and their future squadmates) that they were ready for the big leagues.[/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, we found that the current set of challenges were not as effective as we would have liked, AND the completion of the challenges took some players too much time and effort.[/p][p align="start"]We understand that some players may be concerned about the ease of access opening the door to waves of cheaters; rest assured our anti-cheat team is working hard to address these competitive integrity needs.[/p][p align="start"]Ranked is a great mode, and we want to provide more consistent access moving forward. The more players that can get into Ranked, the higher the overall match quality will be in terms of matchmaking, both for the lobby and for your squadmates.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]UI CLARITY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][h3][b]DEMOTION PROTECTION[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This is an existing feature that provides limited protection to players from being demoted to a lower Rank Tier. [/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, it was an unintentionally hidden feature, which we are giving a glow-up and will be better displayed for players when they are in the protected state.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1foADtBxaJUaqc9eBz74f1/42434d5c61a6c42b7a2e1545c35adc61/demotion_protection.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6,yPosition=0.4759916492693111" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Demotion Protection activates if you are at risk of being demoted to a lower Rank Tier from a single match, i.e. if you end up in a Goliath Match and the heightened entry cost could pull you down. While active, you get three Demotion Shields. Any time you would lose enough RP to be demoted, one Demotion Shield is used, and you will only be demoted after exhausting all of your Demotion Shields. Demotion Protection ends when you either gain enough RP so that it is no longer possible to demote from a single match or if you use all your shields and demote.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]SEASON 32[/b][/h1][p align="start"][i]BIG CHANGES AHEAD. HOLD ON TO YOUR AURAS![/i][/p][p align="start"]Ranked in Apex Legends has always had two distinct player types that keep coming back, season after season. We have our more casually competitive players that drop in for a split, play some games with friends, get promoted a couple of times and then move back to playing other modes. The other group is primarily our highest-skilled players, those that keep pushing through the entire season and generally finish their season in Diamond or Masters.[/p][p align="start"]For the first time in Ranked, we will be formally recognizing each of these groups and creating experiences that better cater to their collective wants and needs.[/p][p align="start"]We will be overhauling the Ranked tier structure and creating a clear separation between what we now call the Open League and the Pro-Am League.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6iGpl2Fdzkdopj6O8FKnyr/0c93cd36f317e1223817f535334ff078/06._Leagues_2.0.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.49537037037037035" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h2][b]NEW RANKS[/b][/h2][h3][b]IRON RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rookie Rank has had a bunch of special rules associated with it that are not really required in Open League. As a result, we have replaced Rookie with Iron, which is treated like a standard rank for all players.[/p][h3][b]EMERALD RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Emerald Rank is new, and sits between Platinum and Diamond. It is the new threshold between Open and Pro-Am Leagues. It will have 4 Divisions, a new badge design, and will be added to Auras, to ensure that there is representation in and out of matches. Emerald Rank should help alleviate the bottleneck many players feel when they climb into Diamond.[/p][h3][b]GRANDMASTER RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Grandmasters Rank will sit at the very top of the Ranked progression runway. It will represent the absolute best of the best. To earn a Predator badge, you will need to land yourself in the top 750 of Grandmaster at the end of the Season.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]OPEN LEAGUE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Open League is where our aspiring Ranked players will fight it out, in hopes of playing in the Pro-Am League. All matches will start in the Dropship.[/p][p align="start"]With the addition of Emerald, there will be a rebalancing of RP values for progression, and you may find yourself adjusting your expectations on how far you are able to advance in this season based on your previous accomplishments. Just remember, everyone is in the same position as you are in dialling in how they place in this new structure![/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]INTRODUCING THE PRO-AM LEAGUE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The Pro-Am League will consist of Diamond, Masters and Grandmasters Rank tiers. Masters Rank will also contain 4 Divisions, to respect the commitment it will take to climb to Grandmasters. Pro-Am matches are where Drop Zone deployment and Legend Banning will live.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]RANKED REWARD CHANGES[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Ranked rewards have been a hot topic for as long as Ranked has existed, and we’re very excited to give a bit of a preview of what changes we have upcoming for this season. If this information seems a bit light, that is intentional. We will have a lot more details to share, with some wicked visuals, closer to Season 32’s launch.[/p][list][*][p]New Seasonal Auras[/p][/*][*][p]New ways to use Auras[/p][/*][*][p]Revisiting Ranked Dive Trails[/p][/*][*][p]Epic & Legendary Apex Packs[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards on Promotion, so you don’t have to wait until end of season[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]RANKED SCORING[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 32 we are overhauling the scoring system to improve the progression experience and make the scoring system easier to understand.[/p][p align="start"]Progression difficulty should gradually increase - not happen all at once - and the experience should be different for an average player compared to a professional player. RP math should be consistent, predictable, and should not require a calculator. [/p][h3][b]SCORE FLATTENING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]First, we are fully flattening the value from kills and placement.[/p][p align="start"]The previous formula allowed RP from kills to scale too much based on final placement, which was contributing to very aggressive hot drops and then ‘holding’ your kills through rounds to allow their value to increase. Starting in Season 32, each kill will be worth a set amount of RP, and each placement is worth a set amount of RP.[/p][p align="start"]By flattening the RP values and removing the multiplier between kills and placement, we expect to see  match pacing even out and players planning how they want to approach kills and survival in a more consistent way.[/p][h3][b]TEAM KILLS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To further clarify the scoring, you will get full kill RP from every kill your team gets regardless of your contribution. [/p][p align="start"]This means assists and participations are being removed.[/p][p align="start"]In addition to simplifying the scoring system, this refocuses individual success around team effort. The Apex Games are a team sport. If you are the team healer and you keep your fraggers alive, you deserve to be equally rewarded for your team’s success. [/p][h3][b]ENTRY COST CHANGES[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We will also be making the entry cost increases more granular by increasing entry cost at each [i][b]division[/b][/i] instead of each tier.[/p][p align="start"]Currently, we see many players hit a hard wall when entering a new Rank Tier ([i]looking at you, Diamond[/i]). With the large jumps in entry cost, it becomes substantially harder to continue netting positive RP.[/p][p align="start"]Increasing the entry cost by division will make progression through each division more competitive, and it will create a clearer measure of skill by separating more players along division lines, not only Rank Tiers.[/p][h3][b]OPEN VS. PRO-AM SCORING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To serve the different player motivations of our more casually competitive players and our highest skill players, the Open League and the Pro-Am League will value Kills and Placement differently.[/p][p align="start"]The Open League will place more importance on gaining kills. Players in these ranks more commonly want to frag-out, and we want the Open League to be the proving grounds of your combat ability. Placement will still be a very effective way to gain RP, kills will just be weighed slightly higher.[/p][p align="start"]The Pro-Am League, on the other hand, will weigh placement higher than kills. We know that our high ranked players want action packed end games, and we want to encourage that by making high placement the best way for these players to gain RP. Plus, as this is the Professional-Ameuteur league, the proportion of total points should be more in line with what the true Apex professionals see in ALGS with highly valuable top-end placement.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]LADDERS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Weekly Ladders are going away as of S32. We’re doing a deep reimagining of what limited-time competition looks like in Apex Legends, and we’ll be talking more about it next year![/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]All of these exciting changes and more, coming in Seasons 31 and 32! We’ll be filling in more details for Season 32 in the lead up to season start, so keep an eye out. And Ranked improvements aren’t stopping at Season 32; make sure to stay tuned for additional updates as the seasons roll on![/p][p]
[/p]

items.title: Blood Pact Event
items.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/1c3b7af66563a4d1fc5bf2d6617cbb568f6904c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Darkness has descended on Kings Canyon. The Arena now belongs to the forces of darkness, and every Legend is pledging their loyalty to Beasts or Demons. Pick your side to gain infernal abilities or sick werewolf powers, then run wild in a haunted Kings Canyon. Whose side will you join?[/p][h3][b]GO FERAL IN WILDCARD[/b] [/h3][p]Pledge to Beasts or Demons in Wildcard, then earn your faction’s Wild Cards by completing challenges throughout the match. Every round throws down a fresh challenge: if you can deal enough damage or land enough knocks, the Wild Card is yours. Run with the Beasts and complete challenges to become a fast-moving monster, with bonus melee movement speed, faster cells and weapon switching, and temporary critical hits on reload. Or side with the Demons to become an infernal powerhouse, with faster ability recharge, high-tier shields, and full shield recharge with just one cell.[/p][h3][b]STALK A HAUNTED KINGS CANYON[/b] [/h3][p]It all goes down on a spooky Kings Canyon. Fog can randomly descend upon the map, hiding squad movement and reducing sightlines, so the smart hunters use it to stalk their prey. Good thing we dusted off Rev Shell Grenades to seek out whoever’s lurking in the dark. Watch for haunted buildings, glowing Nessies, and scares we’ve stashed across the map: haunted Loot Bins, Pumpkin-skinned EVO orbs, and more.[/p][h3][b]FULL MOON FASHION[/b] [/h3][p]Awoooo! Join the forces of darkness in the Blood Pact Store. Go full 80s werewolf with Sparrow’s new Legend Skin and Character Select Animation, or channel inner demons with Alter’s new Legend Skin and the new R-99 Weapon Skin. Descend into darkness with new Beast and Demon Legend Retheme Bundles, and more.[/p]

items.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 10/09/2026
items.contents:
[h2][b]Competitive Integrity Update - Weapon Exploit Fixes[/b][/h2][p]We’ve deployed fixes for multiple high-profile weapon exploits in Apex Legends this week. You may have seen the videos circulating in community spaces earlier this week. [/p][p]These fixes address an exploit that allowed an entire magazine to be fired in a single shot, alongside another that enabled rapid firing and reloading with the Sentinel and C.A.R. SMG beyond their intended functionality.[/p][p]These fixes are part of our broader efforts to protect the integrity of Apex Legends. Alongside addressing exploits, we continue to develop and deploy new anti-cheat detections, strengthen existing systems, and take action against players who undermine fair play. This work is ongoing across multiple fronts, even when individual efforts aren't always immediately visible.[/p][p]
[/p]

items.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update - 10/09/2026
items.contents: [p]📋TESTING: We have activated a matchmaking test that increases maximum queue times for Plat+ players on all platforms, in all regions. The queue time increase scales with Rank tier, and Masters players could expect a maximum extension of approximately 30 seconds.[/p][p]This test is in pursuit of tighter skill bands in high skill matches and less spill over of high rank players into mid-rank matches, as the matchmaker spends more time prioritizing the tightest possible lobbies before expanding its search. This test will run until the end of the season, or until we have enough data.[/p][p]Please continue to give feedback on if you are experiencing tighter matchmaking.[/p]
